# Techjaguar Academy Rewa

Techjaguar Academy is the premier IT and coding institute located in Rewa, Madhya Pradesh. 
We specialize in hands-on, live-project based training designed to make students job-ready.

## Programs Offered
- Full Stack Web Development (MERN Stack)
- Python & Data Science
- Cybersecurity Basics
- C & C++ Programming
- Java Masterclass
- Robotics & IoT

## Training Cum Internship
We offer a dedicated internship program where students build a stunning portfolio while being mentored by industry experts.

## Target Audience
Students, graduates, and professionals in Central India seeking practical tech skills and internships.
